summary_1line: King Marutta, rejected by priest Brihaspati, follows Narada’s advice to seek the eccentric sage Samvarta, who tests his sincerity before agreeing to help.

image_candidates.scene_text: At the gate of Varanasi, King Marutta places a corpse on the ground while a wandering naked ascetic suddenly turns away from it.
The wild sage Samvarta smears King Marutta with mud, ashes, and spittle while the king stands patiently with folded hands.
Exhausted beneath a wide-branched sacred fig tree, the mad-looking sage Samvarta sits while the weary king waits humbly before him.
